techStack: Test runner: Vitest v3.2.4 (NOT Jest) — configured in vite.config.ts with environment:'jsdom', globals:true, setupFiles:'./tests/setup.ts'
@testing-library/user-event v14.6.1 — requires setup() API: const user = userEvent.setup(); await user.click(el)
@testing-library/jest-dom v6.9.1 — initialised in setup.ts via import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
TypeScript v5.7.2, strict mode; test globals (describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi) available without imports
Global fetch mock: vi.stubGlobal('fetch', ...) in beforeEach; vi.unstubAllGlobals() in afterEach — both in setup.ts
Fetch mock default response shape: { ok:true, json: async () => ({ data: [...15products], total:15, page:1, limit:15, totalPages:1 }) }
features: data-testid='results-count': paragraph showing 'Showing N products (page X of Y)'
data-testid='product-{id}': each product card rendered as <article> (role='article')
aria-label='loading': Spinner div shown while isLoading is true
role='alert': error paragraph rendered when fetch fails (rejection or ok:false)
role='status': 'No products found.' paragraph in ProductList when visibleProducts is empty
Form control IDs: search (text input), category (select), inStockOnly (checkbox), sortBy (sort select)
Sort values: 'default', 'price-asc', 'Price: Low to High', 'price-desc' 'Price: High to Low', 'rating-desc' 'Rating'
Buttons: 'Prev' (disabled when page<=1), 'Next' (disabled when page>=totalPages), 'Clear filters'

Products: id1 Wireless Mouse $25 4.3 Electronics inStock | id2 USB-C Hub $60 4.1 Electronics outOfStock | id3 Mechanical Keyboard $95 4.7 Electronics inStock | id4 Webcam HD $79 4.2 Electronics inStock | id5 Noise-Cancelling Headphones $149 4.6 Electronics outOfStock | id6 Yoga Mat $40 4.8 Fitness inStock | id7 Resistance Bands $30 4.0 Fitness inStock | id8 Foam Roller $22 4.4 Fitness inStock | id9 Dumbbell Set $85 4.5 Fitness outOfStock | id10 Jump Rope $15 4.2 Fitness inStock | id11 Laptop Stand $55 4.6 Accessories inStock | id12 Desk Lamp $45 3.9 Accessories outOfStock | id13 Cable Organiser $18 4.1 Accessories inStock | id14 Monitor Riser $38 4.3 Accessories inStock | id15 Ergonomic Wrist Rest $28 4.0 Accessories inStock
Out-of-stock items (4): USB-C Hub(2), Noise-Cancelling Headphones(5), Dumbbell Set(9), Desk Lamp(12) — 11 in stock
architecture: All 6 stub test files already have correct imports: render, screen from '@testing-library/react'; userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'; App from '../src/App'
Each stub has one empty describe block; render(<App />) must be called inside each individual it() block (no beforeEach render)
Async load pattern: await screen.findByTestId('results-count') before any filter/sort interactions — waits for fetch promise to resolve
userEvent v14 pattern per test: const user = userEvent.setup(); then await user.type(), await user.click(), await user.selectOptions()
Error case tests must override the global fetch stub per-test using vi.stubGlobal('fetch', ...) BEFORE render — setup.ts beforeEach runs first, test-level stubGlobal overwrites it
Import path: '../src/App' (tests/ -> src/); no path aliases
Coverage only tracks src/utils/productFilters.ts — no test file constraints beyond not modifying src/
edgeCases: Spinner is synchronous: screen.getByLabelText('loading') must work immediately after render() with NO await — fetch is pending at that point
Error from fetch rejection exposes err.message in the alert; 'Network error' must appear in role='alert' text
ok:false path: override fetch to return { ok:false, json: async () => ({}) } — hook throws 'Failed to fetch products: undefined', role='alert' appears, results-count absent
clearFilters resets ALL four fields: search='', category='All', inStockOnly=false, sortBy='default'
After clearFilters: verify via element.value / element.checked (DOM properties), not just results-count text
Prev disabled: page<=1 (always true for default mock returning page:1, totalPages:1)
Next disabled: page>=totalPages (always true for default mock returning page:1, totalPages:1)
Search is case-insensitive: 'yoga' and 'Yoga' both return 1 result (Yoga Mat)
Combined filter Electronics+inStock: 5 Electronics - 2 outOfStock (USB-C Hub, Noise-Cancelling Headphones) = 3 products
Headphones+inStock=0: 'Noise-Cancelling Headphones' is out of stock, so 0 results and role='status' shows 'No products found.'
rating-desc second place: Mechanical Keyboard (4.7) is second after Yoga Mat (4.8) — must assert data-testid='product-3' at index [1]
Default sort order matches source array: Wireless Mouse (id=1) is first — assert data-testid='product-1' at index [0] without any sort interaction
